newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S&P assigns AA- to Sweden's Helsingborg loan.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns AA- to Sweden's Helsingborg loan.

text.p: Standard & Poor's rating agency said on Thursday it assigned an AA minus rating to the Swedish city of Helsingborg's 55 million crown private placement loan.
It also affirmed an AA minus rating for the city's Issuer Credit Rating and a K-1 rating to its Swedish Commercial Paper programme, saying the ratings' outlooks were stable.
S&P said the ratings reflected Helsingborg's very low debt levels, strong financial operating performance and the local authority's efforts to contain costs.
Helsingborg's sale of its stake in power company Sydkraft had decreased direct debt to 18 percent of revenues.
